description: A warm, luminous farmhouse dining room with an exposed ceiling of white-painted shiplap and three thick reclaimed oak beams running the length of the room. The left wall is entirely glass — large black steel-framed multi-pane sliding or fixed windows looking out onto a sweeping green countryside view with rolling hills and distant forested mountains in summer. The back right wall is smooth warm plaster in a pale greige tone, featuring a deeply recessed arched alcove niche with a flat shelf where several rustic terra cotta and sand-colored ceramic vessels and jugs are displayed. A low sideboard or credenza in natural light oak with simple panel doors sits beneath the niche, holding additional ceramic vases. The dining table is a large rectangular rustic reclaimed wood farm table with thick legs in pale washed oak. Around it sit eight French-style dining chairs with natural linen upholstered seats and backs, paired with natural wood frames. The table is set with white plates, wine glasses, taper candles in short turned wooden candlesticks, and a large round terracotta vase overflowing with small wildflower stems. A natural flat-weave area rug in warm ivory grounds the table. The floor is pale natural oak hardwood. Bright morning or daytime light floods in from the windows, giving the whole room a luminous natural glow. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal to slightly wide lens in a slightly off-center composition that captures the full table, the window wall, and the arched niche together.
